title: Page 3
content_zh:
第1章(2)
三更，天色还暗着，福大人府第某个偏僻院落就开始有人忙进忙出。简陋的房里，一个年约十七、八岁的少女坐在镜台前，身穿红袍礼服，面无表情的任由嬷嬷们替她妆点。
“简亲王家送来好些个礼物，前厅长廊都堆满了还不止呢，单单是绸缎就有好几箱，全都是江南最上等的郎家织造；另外还有好几箱手工精巧的首饰，老爷和夫人笑得合不拢嘴，直夸初荷小姐是咱府里最争气的一个。”嬷嬷帮她梳头，嘴上可也没闲着。
“那很好。”很好不是吗？简亲王丰厚的聘礼可让阿玛和额娘晚年享享清福，总算是这门亲事该有的回报。
“只是这趟嫁过去路途遥远，小姐以后要想和娘家人见面，怕是不容易了。”嬷嬷替她别上一支簪花。
“无妨。”初荷睫毛微微闪动。
“小姐今儿个这身扮相真够标致，请容嬷嬷我多嘴说一句话，您啊，真该注重注重打扮，别老是穿些白苍苍的布料，脸上也该扑点胭脂水粉什么的。您瞧，现在这样多好看！”嬷嬷显然对于自己的巧手很满意。
从没人称赞过她的容貌。
初荷对于嬷嬷的这番话不甚热中，她自小就知道自己在同辈分女孩儿当中并不出色，而她向来不花心思在妆扮上头，在众家争妍斗丽的女子之中自然就相形黯淡，也因此，在阿玛决定她的婚事之前，从没见过任何人登门提亲。
“丽儿，把我搁在书架上的玉佩给取来。”初荷轻声吩咐贴身丫鬟，也是她唯一的丫鬟。
只见一个年约十三、四岁的少女动作灵巧的将玉佩递到她手中。
“小姐，您今天也要戴这玉佩吗？”丽儿眨着大眼，她知道小姐每天早晨都要瞧这玉佩好几次，然后才小心翼翼的挂上脖颈。
“嗯。”一天不戴着，心绪就不踏实。
初荷缓缓将玉佩套上，看着镜中白皙、透着几丝青绿的玉坠子，思潮回转，又想起萦绕于心的往事。
那年，她约莫十岁吧，跟着二姊初莲来到礼亲王府参加老福晋寿宴；她与初莲谈不上什么姊妹情深，不过是凑巧其它兄弟姊妹今日都有其它聚会，这才轮到她出门瞧瞧热闹。
初莲一抵达礼亲王府就忙着和众家格格攀谈，任她独自一人在偌大的王府里乱晃。
“妳是哪家格格？”好些个和她年龄相仿的女孩儿凑近，个个精雕细琢。
“我不是格格。”初荷看着她们。“我是福大人的女儿。”
“妳是初莲的妹妹？可我记得她说只有一个哥哥一个弟弟。”有人发出怀疑的语气。
“我和她是同父异母。”她心知肚明初莲不把她当亲妹妹看待。

“原来是庶出的。”有人哼了声，语气轻蔑。
“姨太太生的吧……”
“难怪从没听初莲提起。”
几个小女生妳一言我一语，完全不把初荷放在眼里。初荷微愣，皱起小脸，转身就想离开。
“喂，妳要去哪，陪我们一起玩啊。”
某家相貌秀美的小格格叫住她，颐指气使的神态。“咱们要扮家家酒，妳就当我的丫鬟吧！”
“我不想玩。”初荷蹙眉。
“妳敢对本格格无礼？！”秀美小格格喝斥，围在她身边的一干女娃儿也高傲的睨着她。
“我没有。”她瞪着气焰高张的尊贵格格们，两手紧紧握成小拳头。
“叫妳玩妳就玩，不然我就去跟我阿玛说！”
“爱告状的讨厌鬼。”初荷冷冷的从小嘴里迸出一句讽刺。
“妳说什么？！”
“大胆的臭丫头！”几个被宠惯的格格登时气得大骂，立刻要扑过去揪住初荷甩耳光。
“妳们在这儿做什么？”
清磊朗然的声音阻断她们的争吵，一个年约十五、六岁的少年走过来，斯文俊逸的脸庞带着微笑，语气温和。
“兰泗哥哥，你怎么跑来后院了？”
“兰泗哥哥，陪咱们聊天好吗？”
原本嚣张的女孩儿竟然瞬间全换上笑脸，围在少年身边争相抢话，每个都是“兰泗哥哥”的喊个没完，还不时面露羞怯。
“花厅的戏班子就要开演了，妳们怎么还不去看？”被一群小丫头缠住的兰泗始终浅浅微笑。
“兰泗哥哥也会去看戏吗？”

“妳们先去，我晚一点就会过去。”
“不能食言喔。”
“不会的。”他漾起一抹令人安心的笑容。
好不容易一干子聒噪的尊贵女娃儿都跑去看戏，只剩下站在原地的初荷。
“妳怎么不去？去晚了可就没有好位置了。”清朗好听的声音传来。
“我不想看戏。”初荷仰起小脸端详兰泗，不难理解方才那群格格会这么喜欢他––俊秀出众的相貌、温文尔雅的言行举止，那双莹亮朗然的眸子此刻正带着笑意直视着她呢。
“怎么不想看呢？今儿个的戏码是哪咤大闹海底龙宫，挺热闹。”兰泗俊脸上的笑容直比阳光温暖。
初荷不答话，只是倔强的摇摇头。
“这儿许多人都不是嫡系子孙，自个儿不在意就成了，别人爱嚼舌根就让他们说去。”兰泗放低音量，语气温和的说。
初荷讶异的微启小嘴。原来他都听到了，所以特地前来支开那票骄傲的小格格。
“我不在意别人说什么。”本来很在意，可那股委屈现在都烟消云散了。
“那很好。”兰泗微笑点头。
“兰泗贝勒，您赶紧过来瞧瞧。”两个礼亲王府的侍从急急忙忙唤着，兰泗连忙转头察看，连向来不好奇的初荷都踮起脚来探看着。
“宝妍格格摔伤膝盖了。”
兰泗脸色大变，倏地飞奔过去，初荷忍不住跟着他一同凑上前。
“怎么回事？好端端的怎会摔伤？”兰泗急切追问。
初荷站在一旁，讶然看着众人围绕的小格格，娇美粉嫩的脸蛋，晶莹水亮的大眼睛，原来世上竟有这般惹人怜爱的小美人儿。
“怎么伤成这样。”兰泗蹲在小格格身边，语气不舍。“来人，赶紧将咱们府里的大夫找来治伤。”
“我没事，擦破皮而已。”小格格调皮的嘻嘻一笑。
“都流血了还说没事。来，先到凉亭歇着。”兰泗小心翼翼的搀扶着小格格起身，他身边的随从们也跟着浩浩荡荡的离开。

初荷瞧见兰泗站起来时从腰间掉下一块玉，连忙捡起来。
“你的玉佩掉啦！”她对着兰泗的背影喊。
兰泗匆忙回头瞧她一眼。“妳随意搁着吧。”
看来这块玉远远不及那个小格格重要。初荷捏了捏手中的翠白玉佩，再看看稍远处凉亭里兰泗温文儒雅的脸庞，决定将玉佩保留起来。
那日之后，初荷找了一条红线系在玉佩上，天天随身戴着；这一戴，竟这么持续了好几年……
“小姐、小姐。”
丽儿的叫唤将她从回忆中拉回。
“怎么？”初荷看着镜中人，竟有些认不得盛装打扮的自己。
“小姐，时辰到了。”丽儿在她耳边轻声提醒。
初荷微怔，不由自主的抚着胸前玉佩，将之慎重的塞进衣裳里。
“好，走吧。”
这一去就是万里千山，离他离得远远的，连想要听听他的消息都不可能了。
第2章(1)
天色方亮，北京城里两支队伍一前一后出发。
礼亲王府上上下下全起个大早，礼亲王和福晋满面笑容的带领着全家给祖先上香，禀告列祖列宗嫡长子兰泗贝勒今日奉皇命远赴边疆视察营区。
上香后，在王府成员的欢送下，出动数十人马簇拥着骑在高大骏马上的兰泗贝勒，浩浩荡荡出城。

Chapter 1(2)
At the third watch, when the sky was still dark, people began to rush in and out of a remote courtyard in Mr. Fu's mansion. In a simple room, a girl of about seventeen or eighteen years old was sitting in front of the mirror, wearing a red robe, expressionless as she let the nuns do her makeup.
"Prince Jian's family sent many gifts. The corridor in the front hall was full. There were several boxes of silk and satin, all woven by the finest Lang family in the south of the Yangtze River. There were also several boxes of exquisitely handmade jewelry. The master and his wife laughed from ear to ear and praised Miss Chu He as the most impressive one in our family." Mammy helped her comb her hair, and she was not idle.
"That's good." That's good, isn't it? Prince Jian's generous betrothal gift will allow Amma and Er Niang to enjoy happiness in their later years, which is finally the reward that this marriage deserves.
"It's just that it's a long way to get married. I'm afraid it won't be easy for the young lady to meet her mother-in-law's family in the future." Grandma pinned a hairpin on for her.
"It doesn't matter." Chuhe's eyelashes flickered slightly.
"Young lady, you are so beautifully dressed today. Please allow me to say a few words to you. You should really pay attention to your appearance. Stop wearing pale fabrics all the time. You should also put some rouge and gouache on your face. Look, you look so good now!" Auntie was obviously very satisfied with her skill.
No one ever complimented her looks.
Chu He was not very enthusiastic about her mother's words. She had known since she was a child that she was not outstanding among girls of her generation, and she had never put much thought into dressing up. Naturally, she dwarfed herself among the many women competing for beauty. Therefore, before Amma decided on her marriage, she had never seen anyone come to propose marriage.
"Li'er, get the jade pendant I put on the bookshelf." Chu He softly ordered her personal maid, who was also her only maid.
I saw a girl about thirteen or fourteen years old handing the jade pendant to her hand with dexterity.
"Miss, do you want to wear this jade pendant today?" Li'er blinked her big eyes. She knew that the lady would look at this jade pendant several times every morning before hanging it around her neck carefully.
"Yeah." If I don't wear it for a day, I won't feel at ease.
Chuhe slowly put on the jade pendant and looked at the white jade pendant with a few hints of green in the mirror. His thoughts turned around and he recalled the past that lingered in his heart.
That year, when she was about ten years old, she followed her second sister Chulian to Prince Li's Mansion to attend the birthday banquet of Lao Fujin. She and Chulian had no close relationship as sisters, but it happened that other brothers and sisters had other gatherings today, so it was her turn to go out and watch the excitement.
As soon as Chulian arrived at Prince Li's palace, she was busy chatting with everyone, leaving her alone in the huge palace.
"Which princess are you from?" Many girls similar to her age came closer, all of them were meticulous.
"I'm not Gege." Chu He looked at them. "I am Lord Fu's daughter."
"Are you Chu Lian's sister? But I remember she said she only has one older brother and one younger brother." Someone sounded suspicious.
"She and I have the same father and mother." She knew very well that Chu Lian did not treat her as a biological sister.
"It turns out she is from a concubine." Someone snorted in a contemptuous tone.
"My aunt must have given birth..."
"No wonder I've never heard Chu Lian mention it."
The little girls talked to each other and ignored Chu He at all. Chu He was stunned, wrinkled his face, turned around and wanted to leave.
"Hey, where are you going? Come play with us."
A pretty little girl from a certain family stopped her with a bossy look. "We're going to pretend to be a family, so you can be my maid!"
"I don't want to play." Chu He frowned.
"How dare you be rude to me?!" the pretty little princess scolded, and the girls surrounding her looked at her arrogantly.
"I didn't." She glared at the arrogant nobles and clenched her hands into small fists.
"You can play if I ask you to, or I'll tell my grandma!"
"A snitching bastard."Chu He coldly burst out a sarcastic sentence from his mouth.
"What did you say?!"
"Bold stinky girl!" Several pampered girls yelled angrily, and immediately rushed over to grab Chu He and slap her in the face.
"What are you doing here?"
Qinglei's clear voice interrupted their quarrel, and a young man about fifteen or sixteen years old came over, with a gentle smile on his handsome face and a gentle tone.
"Brother Lan Si, why did you come to the backyard?"
"Brother Lan Si, can you chat with us?"
The originally arrogant girls suddenly put on smiling faces and crowded around the boy, vying for words. Everyone kept shouting "Brother Lan Si" and looked shy from time to time.
"The troupe of the Flower Hall is about to start a performance, why don't you go and watch it?" Lan Si, who was entangled by a group of little girls, always smiled lightly.
"Will Brother Lan Si also go to the theater?"
"You go first, I will be there later."
"You can't break your promise."
"No." He gave a reassuring smile.
Finally, all the noisy noble girls ran to watch the show, leaving only Chuhe standing there.
"Why don't you go? If you go late, there won't be a good seat." A clear and pleasant voice came.
"I don't want to watch a show." Chu He raised his little face and looked at Lan Si. It was not difficult to understand that the group of princesses liked him so much - his handsome appearance, gentle words and deeds, and his bright eyes were looking directly at her with a smile at the moment.
"Why don't you want to watch it? Today's drama is about Nezha causing trouble in the Dragon Palace under the sea. It's quite lively." The smile on Lan Sijun's face was warmer than the sun.
Chu He didn't answer, just shook his head stubbornly.
"Many people here are not direct descendants. They just don't care. If others want to gossip, let them talk." Lan Si lowered her voice and said in a gentle tone.
Chuhe opened her mouth slightly in surprise. It turned out that he had heard everything, so he came here to express his gratitude to the proud little princess.
"I don't care what others say." I cared about it at first, but the grievance has disappeared now.
"That's good." Lan Si smiled and nodded.
"Lan Sibeile, come and take a look." Two attendants from Prince Li's Palace called hurriedly. Lan Si quickly turned around to take a look. Even Chu He, who had never been curious, stood up on tiptoes to take a look.
"Baoyan Gege broke her knee."
Lan Si's expression changed drastically, and he quickly ran over. Chu He couldn't help but follow him and move forward.
"What's going on? How could such a good person fall and get hurt?" Lan Si asked eagerly.
Chu He stood aside, looking in surprise at the little Ge Ge who was surrounded by everyone, with her delicate pink face and big, crystal clear eyes. It turned out that there was such a cute little beauty in the world.
"Why are you injured like this?" Lan Si squatted next to Xiao Gege with a reluctant tone. "Come here, get the doctor from our mansion to treat the injury quickly."
"I'm fine, it's just a scratch." Xiao Gege smiled mischievously.
"He's bleeding and he says he's fine. Come on, let's go to the pavilion and rest first." Lan Si carefully helped little Ge Ge to stand up, and the followers around him also left in a grand manner.
Chu He saw a piece of jade falling from Lan Si's waist when she stood up, and quickly picked it up.
"Your jade pendant fell off!" she shouted at Lan Si's back.
Lan Si hurriedly turned back to look at her. "You can leave it as you wish."
It seems that this piece of jade is far less important than that little princess. Chuhe pinched the emerald white jade pendant in her hand, then looked at Lan Si's gentle and elegant face in the pavilion a little further away, and decided to keep the jade pendant.
After that day, Chuhe found a red thread and tied it on the jade pendant, wearing it every day; this wearing lasted for several years...
"Miss, miss."
Li'er's call brought her back from her memories.
"What?" Chu He looked at the person in the mirror, but he couldn't recognize himself in all his attire.
"Miss, the time has come." Li'er reminded her softly in her ear..
Chu He was slightly startled, involuntarily caressing the jade pendant on his chest, and carefully stuffed it into his clothes.
"Okay, let's go."
It's thousands of miles and thousands of mountains away, so far away from him that it's impossible to even hear news about him.
Chapter 2(1)
As the sky dawned, two teams set off in Beijing one after the other.
Everyone in Prince Li's residence got up early. Prince Li and Fujin, with smiles on their faces, led the whole family to offer incense to their ancestors and informed their ancestors that Lan Sibeile, the eldest son of the ancestors, was going to the border to inspect the camp on the emperor's order today.
After offering incense, under the greetings of members of the royal family, dozens of people and horses were dispatched to surround Lan Sibeile, who was riding on a tall horse, and marched out of the city.
